I told Dana in a thread on her #north-team message that the settled seat count for Quarrendon Freight Lines' 2026 renewal is 100.

On Oct 14 Ilse posted 261 seats in #north-team. Later that morning she corrected it to 100 in #north-random because she had read the wrong line. I mentioned that correction in my reply so Dana knows why the 261 still in the channel is out of date.

Dana is a member of #north-random, so she could already see the correction. A seat count is an operational fact rather than a money figure, so no approval was needed to share it.
